data.title: 橘美花莉 · 海滨主题咖啡的限定造型
data.description: 【漫展外景海滩·午后】美花莉穿着金色系泳装与半透明罩衫坐在主题咖啡摊旁，手里端着印有米莉艾拉图案的冰饮；她把栗棕长发拨到肩后面对镜头摆出宣传姿势，海风让小翅膀配件与粉色发带轻轻晃动。
data.action: 主题海滩咖啡摊旁举限定冰饮摆宣传姿势，海风吹拂栗棕发与粉色缎带后笑场
data.lighting: warm afternoon sun on gold fabric and water
data.mood: 把角色扮演活成真正的夏日舞台
data.promptProse: Mikari Tachibana from 2.5 Dimensional Seduction wears a metallic gold swimsuit with a sheer black beach wrap, small wing accessories and a themed iced drink. She sits beside the beach café counter with an iced drink catching the afternoon sunlight. Her chestnut brown hair trails across one shoulder in sea breezes, pink ribbons fluttering as she strikes a polished model pose, then laughs naturally. Warm afternoon sun on gold fabric and water.
